verdict.rationale: Notte is a browser automation/agentic-scraping infrastructure product (remote browsers, structured data extraction from websites, MCP/CLI control) rather than a product that holds a user's own dataset and surfaces AI-generated insights/suggestions from it. The evidence only shows AI extracting data from external websites on request, which is a different axis (agentic scraping) than 'insights from my data inside the product' — this is a category mismatch, not a missing feature.
